proposalWaits: 🟡 Waiting for your answer on its card
moreProposals: {count, plural, one {One more proposal follows} other {# more proposals follow}} once you answer this card
budget: Chat paused until {when}: today's model budget is spent. Orders keep running.
stopped: Stopped. Anything you already confirmed still goes through.
stoppedCardOpen: 🟡 Stopped. The card of its proposal is still open: answer it there.
toolCallLimit: Stopped: this answer reached its limit of 25 tool calls. Ask again to go on.
modelCallLimit: Stopped: this answer reached its limit of 40 model calls. Ask again to go on.
loop: Stopped: the agent repeated the same step three times.
failed.transient: The model provider did not answer, even after retries. Try again in a minute.
failed.context: This chat is too long to go on. Send /clear to start a new one; your notes and strategy stay.
failed.auth: The model provider refused the key. Run `binference check` on the machine.
failed.billing: The model key reached its spending limit. Raise it with the provider, or pick another model with /ai.
failed.request: The model provider refused the request. Pick another model with /ai, or run `binference check`.
failed.refused: The model stopped under its provider's own safety rules.
failed.aborted: Stopped before the answer was complete.
failed.timeLimit: Stopped: this answer ran for 10 minutes. Ask again to go on.
failed.proposalUnknown: ⚠️ binference did not hear back about a proposal, so it was not sent again. Check your open cards.
failed.engine: Stopped: the agent lost its link to the engine. It starts again by itself.
image.tooMany: Not read: a message takes at most {count} images. Send the rest in another message.
image.tooLarge: Not read: an image is over the {mib} MiB limit. Send a smaller one.
image.format: Not read: only PNG, JPEG and WebP images can be read. Send the image in one of these formats.
image.unreadable: Not read: binference could not fetch an image. Send it again.
image.noVision: Not read: the agent's model cannot read images and no vision model is set. Set `models.vision` in config.json5, or list the model in `models.imageInput`, then send the image again.
firstChatDone: Saved your answers to STRATEGY.md and PERSONA.md. Ask the agent to change them any time.
